# Write refusals tell the user to "edit that directive" when the directive was generated by a plugin

**Minor · cli · 20–30m · A1.** Real CLI QA, 2026-10-11, HEAD `a8b75aed` (CLI unchanged since `97600b74`), checkout `bea 0.3.1`, macOS.
When a write is refused because of a close or balance assertion that a
plugin synthesised, the remedy points at it as if it were a line in the
file: `Account closed 2024-06-01 at <beancount.plugins.close_tree>:0 …
edit that directive`, or "the existing assertion at main.bean:19" where
line 19 is a `close`. The refusals are correct; the guidance names
something that does not exist. No product fix implemented.

Create disposable `/absolute/books/c1/main.bean`:

```beancount
option "operating_currency" "USD"
plugin "beancount.plugins.close_tree"
2024-01-01 open Assets:Bank USD
2024-01-01 open Equity:Opening
2024-01-01 open Expenses:Food USD
2024-01-01 open Expenses:Food:Groceries USD
2024-01-01 open Expenses:Food:Dining USD

2024-01-02 * "Opening"
  Assets:Bank  1000.00 USD
  Equity:Opening

2024-02-01 * "Shop"
  Expenses:Food:Groceries  40.00 USD
  Assets:Bank

2024-06-01 close Expenses:Food
```

and `/absolute/books/d1/main.bean`:

```beancount
option "operating_currency" "USD"
plugin "beancount.plugins.check_drained"
2024-01-01 open Assets:Bank USD
2024-01-01 open Assets:Old USD
2024-01-01 open Equity:Opening

2024-01-02 * "Opening"
  Assets:Bank  1000.00 USD
  Equity:Opening

2024-01-03 * "Move in"
  Assets:Old  50.00 USD
  Assets:Bank

2024-01-20 * "Move out"
  Assets:Old  -50.00 USD
  Assets:Bank

2024-02-01 close Assets:Old
```

Use isolated BEA_CONFIG_DIR/XDG_CACHE_HOME, BEA_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1, no
inherited BEA_FILE/BEA_TOKEN, closed stdin, no TTY, cwd `/absolute/books`.

```sh
bea -f c1/main.bean add transaction --date 2024-07-01 Shop -p 'Expenses:Food:Groceries 5.00 USD' -p Assets:Bank
bea -f d1/main.bean add transaction --date 2024-01-25 late -p 'Assets:Old 5.00 USD' -p Assets:Bank
```

Actual: both exit 1 and write nothing.

```text
c1: Invalid reference to inactive account 'Expenses:Food:Groceries' Account opened 2024-01-01 at /absolute/books/c1/main.bean:6. Account closed 2024-06-01 at <beancount.plugins.close_tree>:0. Correct the transaction date or edit that directive; …

d1: /absolute/books/d1/main.bean:19: Balance failed for 'Assets:Old': expected 0 USD != accumulated 5.00 USD (5.00 too much)
    … Review transactions against the existing assertion at /absolute/books/d1/main.bean:19. Correct missing transactions or edit that assertion; adding another balance would duplicate it.
```

In `d1`, line 19 is `2024-02-01 close Assets:Old`; the file contains no
assertion.

Control: `c1` without the plugin and with a written `close
Expenses:Food:Groceries` reports `Account closed 2024-06-01 at
/absolute/books/c2/main.bean:16`, a real editable line. A worker saw the
same misdirection for `check_closing` (`existing assertion at
<check_closing>:0`).

Expected: `docs/USAGE.md` treats plugin-synthesised directives as
generated, not on disk, and the `add price` guard already skips them. A
remedy should name something the user can edit: the parent `close
Expenses:Food` at line 17, or the `close` at line 19 described as a close
checked by the plugin.

Cause: `cli/src/bea_engine/ledger/write.py:708-713` appends a location for
every loaded open/close of the account without asking whether it is
generated; `write.py:404-409` (`_balance_recovery_hints`) treats any
failing balance whose line number fits the file as a written assertion.

Fix: in both places, when the entry is generated, say it comes from the
plugin (and, where the plugin borrows a real line, name that line for what
it is) and drop the "edit that directive/assertion" sentence. No dependency
or API change.

Blast radius: the refusal text of every `add` type, `add transactions`
and `import --apply` on ledgers using `close_tree`, `check_closing`,
`check_drained` or any plugin emitting opens, closes or balances.

Dedupe: board search for "edit that directive", "existing assertion",
`close_tree`, `check_closing` and `check_drained` finds w5/152 (the same
class in `add balance`'s duplicate guard, a different function) and w5/076
(the inactive-account sentence for a written open); listing of generated
entries is w3/done/320.

Acceptance: the `c1` message names the plugin and the written `close
Expenses:Food` line, not `<…>:0` as something to edit; the `d1` message
does not call line 19 an assertion; the written-close control is
unchanged. Only macOS and the checkout were exercised.
